description: Create a macro nutrition tracking spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/macro_log.xlsx. Log yesterday's food intake: Greek yogurt (1 cup), banana (1 medium), granola (0.5 cup), grilled chicken breast (6 oz), brown rice (1 cup cooked), broccoli (1 cup), protein shake (1 scoop), almond butter (2 tbsp), salmon fillet (5 oz), sweet potato (1 medium), green beans (1 cup). For each food, enter protein, carbohydrates, and fat values in grams. Add SUM formulas to calculate totals for each macro. Add a row showing targets: 150g protein, 200g carbs, 60g fat. Add a row calculating the difference between totals and targets. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
